title: TERRA BELLUM
tagline: A turn-based chronicle of the globe
pick_nation: Tap a province to claim its nation
err_needport: A port is needed to cross the sea
mp_pick_hint: Tap a province to claim its nation
tut_1_b: You rule a nation made of provinces. Tap any province to see it. The bar at the top shows your gold, manpower, move points (MP) and diplomacy points (DP).
tut_2_b: Recruit troops in your provinces, then press Move army and tap a neighbouring province. Moving into enemy land attacks it; you can also right-click a target. Neutral land is claimed by Colonize.
tut_3_b: Declare war from a nation card or a province. Occupy enemy provinces to raise your war score, then demand land or white peace. Long occupations annex provinces.
tut_4_b: Build farms, markets and libraries. The Budget screen sets taxes, public goods, research and investment. Research unlocks eras; gold can also hire mercenaries.
tut_5_b: Open Nations to see rulers, war scores and relations. Propose non-aggression pacts or alliances. Allies join your wars; broken pacts are remembered.
tut_6_b: Historical and random events ask for decisions. Hold 60% of the world to win. Press End turn when you are ready: each turn is six months.
err_vassal: Already part of a subject chain
q_auto_down: Graphics lowered to keep the game smooth
vc_diplomatic_d: Hold 8 or more alliances at once.
al_none: All quiet. Nothing needs your attention.
al_bankrupt: The treasury is empty and still losing money — troops are deserting. Raise taxes or cut spending.
al_low_treasury: Treasury will run out in about {k} turn(s). Adjust the budget.
al_capital_lost: Your capital has fallen! Provinces are unstable until you retake it or move the capital.
al_threat: Enemy army {r}x stronger than yours is massing at the border. Reinforce or sue for peace.
al_occupied: {k} of your province(s) are under enemy occupation (they are annexed after a while).
al_unrest: {k} province(s) are close to revolt. Lower taxes, build, or garrison them.
al_war_winning: You hold {k}% war score. Demand land or a vassal from the nation card.
al_idle_gold: You are hoarding {k} gold. Build, recruit or develop provinces.
al_idle_mp: Action points are at their cap — spend them on diplomacy or covert ops.
al_idle_men: Manpower is full. Recruit troops while it is free.
al_no_research: Research budget is 0%. You will fall behind technologically.
al_peacetime: Peace and a full purse: a good time to build or develop.
e_ruler_crisis: {a}: {old} has died — a succession crisis shakes the realm! {new} claims the throne.
al_coalition: Your infamy ({k}) has united the world against you — every nation now has a casus belli on you. Avoid conquest and unjustified wars until it falls below 12.
al_infamy: Infamy is {k}. At 22 a coalition forms against you. Wars with a casus belli and peace help it fade.
dec_conscript_d: +30% manpower for 12 turns, but subjects grow unhappy.
dec_propaganda_d: Faster stability recovery and happier subjects for 10 turns.
dec_fortify_d: All provinces gain +15 defence at once (max 50).
dec_amnesty_d: Lowers infamy by 8. Once per 20 turns.
err_era: Your nation is not advanced enough.
err_noinfamy: You have no infamy to reduce.
blurb_modern: The world as it stands: nuclear powers, shifting alliances, hundreds of nations.
blurb_ancient: Rome and Carthage clash as Qin unifies China. Phalanxes, war elephants, tribal kings.
blurb_roman: Hadrian's Rome at its greatest extent, facing Parthia across the Euphrates.
blurb_medieval: The First Crusade marches. Feudal kingdoms, caliphates and steppe confederations.
blurb_mongol: The Mongol khanates hold the largest land empire in history.
blurb_timurid: Timur's armies tear across Asia while the Ottomans rise in the west.
blurb_discovery: Columbus sails. Spain, Portugal and the Ottomans begin to reshape the world.
blurb_gunpowder: Musket and cannon empires: Louis XIV, Peter the Great, Aurangzeb.
blurb_napoleonic: Napoleon bestrides Europe while the old empires gather against him.
blurb_victorian: Steam, rails and colonies. The Great Powers carve up the globe.
blurb_ww1: Alliances lock Europe into a war nobody can stop. Trenches, machine guns, empires.
blurb_ww2: Fascism, communism and democracy collide in the largest war ever fought.
blurb_coldwar: Two superpowers, a nuclear shadow, and a world dividing into blocs.
stats_wait: History builds up as turns pass.

ev_mercenary_company_f: A battle-hardened company of sell-swords has arrived seeking employment.
ev_plague_f: A dark pestilence moves through your cities; the roads are choked with the fearful.

ev_plague_d1: No cost · stability -12 · larger population loss

ev_noble_revolt_d0: -60 gold · -20 army in the capital · stability -8
ev_peasant_uprising_f: The common folk rise against heavy taxation and endless war.

ev_scholar_discovery_f: A learned scholar presents a treatise that could transform your civilization.
ev_military_mutiny_f: Unpaid soldiers beat their shields in the night. The treasury must answer, or the swords turn inward.
ev_military_innovation_f: A veteran general proposes a new tactical doctrine that could transform your army.
